title: Trump’s Canadian Tariffs Tear at Bond Between Twins Towns in Ontario and Michigan
summary_full: A 50 percent U.S. tariff on Canadian steel is crippling a major Ontario mill, driving mass layoffs and rupturing a century of cross-border life with Michigan.
